methodology.rule: Fix shared causes before local symptoms; preserve product identity and game logic.

product_principles: Map is the hero and primary gameplay surface.
Persistent HUD must stay minimal and readable.
All primary management modules use one uniform centered modal shell.
Color and motion communicate state, not decoration.
Mobile touch ergonomics are a release requirement.

body.ordinary_floor: 14px in dense game UI; 16px for prose

typography.compact_label_floor: 9px only for non-critical auxiliary HUD labels

modal_contract.scroll: internal body scroll with stable header

surfaces.default: solid dark surfaces with subtle borders
surfaces.cards: use only when an entity/action needs separation

navigation.dock: high-level navigation only; inactive items visually quiet
navigation.resource_bar: one continuous status strip, not four independent cards

icons.rule: one icon family; consistent stroke and optical size

accessibility.testids: preserve existing data-testid attributes; add to new important interactive controls

map.ui_rule: overlays must not obscure essential map interaction
